units.report_text: At n3, blue in p0 is a time-12 history estimate using feedback through 11; p1 is a completed time-12 native record. Both concentrate at row 1, column 3 (0.999944). P0 estimates retain the feedback boundary through 11. Both panels prefer k1 by maximum supplied localization probability, margin 0.765325. These are model/readout values, not calibrated confidence or physical truth; preference denotes operation-score selection, not a Controller action or an executed outcome.
